description: Complete standalone implementation of Rose 5-tier SQLite schema with Hazard Trigger gacha mechanics, React/TypeScript SPA frontend, FastAPI Python backend, and Master UI/UX template compliance

architecture.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Zustand + Tailwind CSS
architecture.database: SQLite 5-tier relational (quotes, containers, specifics, themes, usages)

execution_phases.name: Project Scaffold
execution_phases.description: Initialize project structure, package configurations, and development environment

implementation_spec.description: Create root project files with proper TypeScript/Vite configuration
key_requirements: Tailwind CSS with theme tokens matching Master UI template

implementation_spec.description: Initialize Python backend structure with FastAPI dependencies
Create React application entry points and type definitions
key_requirements: Zustand store pattern from existing Studio implementations

execution_phases.name: Backend Foundation
execution_phases.description: Implement SQLite 5-tier schema, Pydantic models, and FastAPI CRUD endpoints

implementation_spec.description: Port Rose 5-tier SQLite schema with WAL mode, foreign keys, and connection pooling
key_requirements: Exact Rose schema replication: quotes(0001), containers(0002), specifics(0003), themes(0004), usages(0005)
SQLite WAL mode with IMMEDIATE transactions

database_schema.quotes: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, idx INTEGER UNIQUE, main_content TEXT NOT NULL, context TEXT, date TEXT, specific_id TEXT, theme_ids TEXT, usage_ids TEXT, preference TEXT, backlinks TEXT
database_schema.containers: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, type TEXT, notes TEXT
database_schema.specifics: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, container_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES containers(id), category TEXT, default_usage_ids TEXT, notes TEXT
database_schema.themes: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, child_of TEXT REFERENCES themes(id), notes TEXT
database_schema.usages: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, icon TEXT, conflicts_with TEXT

implementation_spec.description: Create strongly-typed Pydantic models matching exact Rose schema
key_requirements: Hex ID validation with regex patterns
JSON serialization for array fields (theme_ids, usage_ids, conflicts_with)
Zero untyped dictionaries across all models

implementation_spec.description: Implement async CRUD operations with proper error handling and transaction management
key_requirements: Proper exception handling with specific error types
Hex ID generation with timestamp encoding

operation_coverage.create: All entities with auto-generated hex IDs
operation_coverage.read: Single by ID, list all, filtered queries

implementation_spec.description: RESTful API endpoints with proper HTTP status codes, CORS, and error handling
key_requirements: FastAPI router pattern with proper dependency injection
Standardized error responses with detail messages

implementation_spec.description: Port Rose compile_projections.py logic with zero LLM dependencies
key_requirements: Exact replication of Rose CQRS projection compilation
Denormalized JSON output matching Rose quotes_map.json and taxonomy_index.json
Default usage IDs propagation from specifics
O(1) lookup optimization for frontend consumption

output_format.quotes_projection: { [hex_id]: { id, index, main_content, context, date, specific, themes[], usages[], preference[], backlinks[] } }

execution_phases.name: Frontend Implementation
execution_phases.description: React/TypeScript SPA with Zustand store, Hazard theme, and Master UI/UX template compliance

implementation_spec.description: TypeScript definitions matching backend Pydantic models and HTTP client
key_requirements: Exact TypeScript equivalents of Pydantic models
Fetch-based API client with proper error handling

api_patterns.error_handling: Standardized ApiError class with HTTP status codes
api_patterns.client_methods: Async functions for each CRUD endpoint

implementation_spec.description: Zustand state management following Studio pattern with proper TypeScript integration
key_requirements: Async action creators with error handling
Store slicing for modular state management
LocalStorage persistence for UI preferences only

store_structure.quote-store: quotes[], selectedQuote, loading, error, CRUD actions
store_structure.taxonomy-store: containers[], specifics[], themes[], usages[], denormalized data
store_structure.hazard-trigger-store: gacha pool state, node weights, exclusion rules (future expansion)

implementation_spec.description: Reusable UI components following Master UI/UX template patterns
key_requirements: Fitts's Law compliance with full-surface hitboxes
Theme-agnostic design tokens via CSS custom properties
TypeScript prop interfaces with proper typing

component_features.Button: Primary/secondary variants, loading states, full-width option
component_features.Input: Text/textarea variants, validation states, focus management
component_features.Dropdown: Single select with search, create options, persistent suggestions
component_features.MultiSelect: Tag chips, inline input, suggestion pool management
component_features.TreeView: Hierarchical data, breadcrumb navigation, single-path focus

implementation_spec.description: Main application features integrating UI components with business logic

component_responsibilities.QuoteEditor: Create/edit quotes, field validation, submission handling
component_responsibilities.QuoteList: Paginated list, filtering, sorting, selection management
component_responsibilities.SearchInterface: Real-time filtering, faceted search, result highlighting
component_responsibilities.FieldMappingControls: Associate quotes with taxonomy entities, conflict resolution

implementation_spec.description: Application layout, navigation, and routing implementation
key_requirements: Single-page application (no React Router needed initially)

layout_structure.Header: Title, theme switcher, export controls, status indicators
layout_structure.Navigation: Tab-based view switching, active state management
layout_structure.Layout: Responsive grid, sidebar management, main content area
layout_structure.StatusPanel: Live JSON inspector, operation status, connection health

implementation_spec.description: Hazard theme integration with Master UI template design tokens
key_requirements: CSS custom properties for all color/spacing tokens
Dark/light theme support with system preference detection
Typography scale with proper contrast ratios

implementation_spec.description: Data export capabilities for external tool integration
key_requirements: Export format validation and error handling

export_formats.json: Complete quote data with taxonomy relationships
export_formats.comfyui: Formatted prompts for AI image generation
export_formats.clipboard: Quick copy for individual quotes or selections

critical_invariants: Hex ID prefixes strictly enforced (0001-0005 for quotes, containers, specifics, themes, usages)
SQLite WAL mode with IMMEDIATE transactions for data integrity
Zero sentiment field in quotes table (removed from original Rose schema)
Foreign key constraints enforced throughout database
No untyped dictionaries passing between frontend/backend layers
Master UI/UX template compliance with zero-dead-zones and single-active-branch outliner
Deterministic graph resolver with zero LLM dependencies
4-tier clean separation: UI -> Store -> API -> Database
Maximum 300 lines per file across all modules
Rose pattern compliance for all CQRS projections

dependency_waves.description: Project scaffolding can be done in parallel
Backend core must be built sequentially due to dependencies
API endpoints and graph resolver can be built in parallel
Frontend foundation requires API client before state management
UI components and styling can be developed in parallel

verification_checklist: SQLite database initializes with proper 5-tier schema
Hex ID generation works with correct prefixes
Foreign key constraints prevent orphaned records
CQRS projections compile correctly matching Rose format
API endpoints return proper HTTP status codes
Frontend components match Master UI template patterns
Theme switching works between light/dark modes
Responsive design works on mobile and desktop
Error handling provides meaningful user feedback
